hero.title: Jaipur National University
hero.summary: Jaipur National University offers a four-year agriculture honours degree through its School of Agricultural Sciences. The published course outline covers crop and soil sciences alongside practical modules such as seed production, mushroom cultivation and testing. Agriculture admission requirements are listed separately from other science degrees.

overview.heading: Agriculture teaching within JNU Jaipur
paragraphs: Jaipur National University is a self-financed private institution sponsored by Mahima Shiksha Samiti. Its School of Agricultural Sciences presents agricultural study within the university’s wider range of programmes. The agriculture undergraduate listing gives a four-year honours degree and a selection description of JET plus personal interview.

The degree outline spans crop production and allied agricultural sciences, with a substantial list of practical modules. Applicants can use that curriculum to compare their interests in seed work, cultivation, soils or enterprise. Ask the school which experiential modules are running for the intended batch and request the current programme handbook, since the website contains both updated academic material and older FAQ text.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The four-year degree covers agronomy, soils, plant breeding, crop protection and related disciplines. The published curriculum lists practical choices in seed production, mushroom cultivation, testing and beekeeping.
programmes.eligibility: The official UG listing states 10+2 with minimum 50% in Science/Agriculture. The subject-combination text is incomplete on the page; obtain the current prospectus before assessing individual eligibility.
programmes.admission_route: Official agriculture pages state JET + personal interview. Confirm the current entry-year procedure directly with the school.

fees.note: The official page displays ₹75,100 tuition but does not establish a clear academic year and charging period. The amount is not converted into an annual or total-degree fee; lab/library costs are stated separately.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Jaipur National University, Jaipur for 2022-07-19 to 2027-07-18. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to JNU Jaipur
admissions.intro: JNU Jaipur’s agriculture listing gives a 50% Science/Agriculture threshold and JET plus personal interview. The university also runs a wider scholarship-test process; do not assume that this replaces the agriculture-specific selection route.
eligibility_points: The agriculture UG page states a minimum 50% at 10+2 in Science/Agriculture.
The exact accepted subject combination requires confirmation because the online entry is truncated.

steps.title: Confirm the current prospectus
steps.text: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application.

steps.title: Request a written cost statement
steps.text: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

campus.heading: Practical modules and agricultural visits
campus.intro: The published agriculture outline includes hands-on subject modules and describes visits to research and agricultural institutions. This is curricular information, not a guarantee of a particular destination or visit for every student.

facilities.name: Agriculture practical facilities identified in FAQ
facilities.description: The school FAQ identifies soil-science, entomology and crop-physiology laboratory work alongside agronomy fields, a horticulture orchard and farm machinery. This is a source list of learning settings, not a verified capacity or access schedule.

practical_learning: The published eighth-semester list includes seed production, mushroom cultivation and soil/plant/water/seed testing modules.
The course page describes educational visits to agricultural research, extension and industry settings.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The university has a scholarships and financial-assistance page. The agriculture course page simply refers to university norms; a dated agriculture-specific award schedule and its renewal conditions were not verified.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: Jaipur National University’s NIRF 2025 Agriculture and Allied Sectors submission reports UG four-year programme-category outcomes for three past graduating cohorts. The figures below retain that reporting scope and are not university-wide packages or promises for a new applicant.

faqs.question: Which school teaches agriculture at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The university has a School of Agricultural Sciences and publishes a separate agriculture UG listing.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture?
faqs.answer: Both official agriculture pages specify four years.

faqs.question: Is the displayed ₹75,100 a verified annual fee?
faqs.answer: No. The readable page does not clearly establish its academic year and charging period, and says lab/library fees are separate. Request an itemised current schedule.

faqs.question: What selection method is listed?
faqs.answer: The agriculture programme pages list JET plus personal interview. Confirm current rules for the intended entry year.

faqs.question: Why is an older website FAQ about accreditation not followed?
faqs.answer: The page includes a stale pre-accreditation FAQ. The ICAR register records the agriculture term from 19 July 2022 to 18 July 2027; the discrepancy is logged for correction.

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practical facilities identified in FAQ: The school FAQ identifies soil-science, entomology and crop-physiology laboratory work alongside agronomy fields, a horticulture orchard and farm machinery. This is a source list of learning settings, not a verified capacity or access schedule.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Jaipur National University is recorded as established in 2007.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: https://apply.jnujaipur.ac.in/. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: 1800-102-1900; Public email: admissions@jnujaipur.ac.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
